question: A radiation of wavelength $6.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ m}$ and another radiation of wavelength $2.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ m}$ are travelling in vacuum. Compare their frequencies and identify which one has greater photon energy. Justify your answer.

options.A: The radiation of wavelength $6.0\times10^{-7}\text{ m}$ has three times the frequency and photon energy of the radiation of wavelength $2.0\times10^{-7}\text{ m}$.
options.B: Both radiations have the same frequency and photon energy because both travel in vacuum.
options.C: The radiation of wavelength $2.0\times10^{-7}\text{ m}$ has twice the frequency and photon energy of the radiation of wavelength $6.0\times10^{-7}\text{ m}$.
